note: Sites 045 and 048 on the north side of Sand Mountain Road, about 0.9 km apart, both described as larger sites suitable for trailers and open to horse trailers, in full sun, one camping unit each. 045, near the Summit Trail, is the pull-through: a grass loop graded moderate to a clearing about 15 m across, where DCNR's map layer lists no picnic table. 048, east of the Faust Valley Trail, is a back-in at the end of an 800-ft gravel driveway graded severe, which drops about 23 m from the road to a gravel clearing roughly 40 m by 25 m. Fire rings, nothing else. About 4 to 4.5 miles of Sand Mountain Road from US 322. State forest roads are not plowed in winter, and some Bald Eagle roads need 4WD and high clearance: check the route. --Claude
summary: Both site pages re-read: open year round, bookable (nights offered; some November nights already reserved), $10/$15 + $6.50, 50 ft, 14-ft clearance. 045 pull-through on grass, moderate; 048 back-in on gravel, severe, 800 ft. Imagery rendered (leaf-off): 045 a ~15 m clearing 42 m north of the road with a track looping through; 048 a ~40 x 25 m gravel clearing. 3DEP: 045 2.6 m above the road; 048 pad 560 m vs Sand Mountain Road 583 m about 130 m to the SE (about 9% mean over the 800-ft driveway). NHD: Big Poe Creek (intermittent reach) 83 m from 048; none within 200 m of 045. pull_through stays true (045 only).
flags: 048 DRIVEWAY: 'Driveway Grade: Severe', 800 ft of gravel; 3DEP shows about 23 m of descent from Sand Mountain Road (about 9% mean). If that rules a 23-ft motorhome out, the usable count is 1 (045).
045 SURFACE: the pull-through driveway is GRASS ('Driveway Surface: Grass', 975 ft, 'Driveway Grade: Moderate'); soft when wet. DCNR GIS: PicnicTables 'No'.

Kind of place: both carry the 'Horse Site' category and DCNR GIS describes them as 'Larger site, suitable for horse trailers' (TrailerAccess 'Yes' on both). They are single reservable campsites, not a horse camp or staging lot; kept.
No 'RV Site' among the equipment categories on any Bald Eagle site page in this entry (both 'Horse Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site'): by the brief that is keep, flagged.
Waterfront: Big Poe Creek is 83 m from 048 as an intermittent NHD reach, beyond 50 m and not visible on imagery; no upgrade lead.
Spacing: about 0.9 km along one road; no split recommended.
Forest-wide 4WD/high-clearance line; road surface and weight limits unread (Overpass did not answer).
